QUOTE: "The right side is matched against the tool name plus the first string value in the args JSON (`ServerManager::args_to_pattern`, `server_manager.cpp:426`). Empty args, `{}`, or a non-string first value all become `*`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says only the first string argument value reaches the pattern and that empty or non-string first values collapse to `*`. That covers the single-value and wildcard-collapse parts. It does not state outright that the other arguments are invisible to matching, but that follows directly from only the first being matched.
